import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()
    R = int(data[0])
    C = int(data[1])
    if R > C:
        R, C = C, R
    
    # dp[c][m1][m2] = min spoders in first c columns
    dp = [[[69] * (1 << R) for _ in range(1 << R)] for __ in range(C + 1)]
    for mask in range(1 << R):
        dp[0][0][mask] = 0
    
    for c in range(1, C + 1):
        for mask1 in range(1 << R):
            for mask2 in range(1 << R):
                for mask3 in range(1 << R):
                    works = True
                    for b in range(R):
                        if (mask2 & (1 << b)) == 0:
                            if b > 0 and (mask2 & (1 << (b - 1))) > 0:
                                pass
                            elif b + 1 < R and (mask2 & (1 << (b + 1))) > 0:
                                pass
                            elif (mask1 & (1 << b)) > 0:
                                pass
                            elif (mask3 & (1 << b)) > 0:
                                pass
                            else:
                                works = False
                    if works:
                        dp[c][mask2][mask3] = min(dp[c][mask2][mask3], dp[c-1][mask1][mask2] + bin(mask1).count('1'))
    
    res = 0
    for mask in range(1 << R):
        res = max(res, R * C - (dp[C][mask][0] + bin(mask).count('1')))
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
